item.title: Wakulla County Extension Office seeks public input for new community market
item.description: The Extension Office has distributed an online survey to gauge resident interest for a new market and plan to host a public forum soon.

item.title: FSU engineering professor returns to "Survivor" island for 50th season
item.description: Professor Christian Hubicki returns for season 50 of "Survivor" after finishing 7th in his first appearance on the show. He hopes his performance will inspire his students to take risks.

item.title: Florida advocates return to Capitol demanding protection for HIV patients facing program cuts
item.description: Florida lawmakers face a critical decision as 16,000 residents could lose access to HIV medication assistance. The House proposes $68M while the Senate suggests $118M to bridge the funding gap.
